articles.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
articles.excerpt: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.
articles.summary: 为 Claude Code 定制的 29 种编辑级图表模板，全部由自包含 HTML + SVG 实现，摒弃阴影和 Mermaid 风格的花哨输出。用于生成干净专业的图表，适合文档撰写、技术演示和内容创作场景。

articles.title: semantica-agi/semantica
articles.excerpt: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
articles.summary: 基于图结构的 AI 基础设施，为上下文管理和可问责 AI 系统提供底层支撑。通过图原生架构组织知识、追踪推理链路，适用于需要可解释、可审计 AI 决策的企业级应用与智能体平台。

articles.title: anthropics/skills
articles.excerpt: Public repository for Agent Skills
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方发布的 Agent Skills 公共仓库，定义了一套标准化的技能封装格式。开发者可复用、分享 Claude 的技能模块，让 AI 代理具备文件操作、API 调用等特定能力，是构建复杂 Agent 应用的参考资源。

articles.title: cactus-compute/needle
articles.excerpt: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
articles.summary: 体积仅 14MB 的轻量级基础模型，专为手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人等小型终端设计。在资源受限的边缘设备上本地运行 AI 推理，无需云端连接，兼顾隐私保护与低延迟响应。

articles.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
articles.excerpt: Fastest and only macOS Dictation app with on-device STT and custom trained AI enhancement model. A local Wispr Flow alternative. ⭐ helps a ton :) Windows & iOS waitlist open. Linux soon.
articles.summary: macOS 上最快的本地听写应用，内置设备端 STT 和自训练的 AI 增强模型，是 Wispr Flow 的本地替代方案。无需上传音频即可完成语音转文字，适合注重隐私、追求低延迟输入效率的用户，Windows 与 iOS 版本即将推出。

articles.title: unslothai/unsloth
articles.excerpt: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
articles.summary: 提供本地图形界面，用于运行和微调 LLM 与扩散模型，支持 Qwen、Kimi、Gemma、DeepSeek-V4、FLUX 等主流模型。零基础用户也能在本地完成模型训练与推理，适合个人开发者与研究者快速实验和部署。

articles.title: macro-inc/macro
articles.excerpt: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
articles.summary: 面向团队的统一工作空间，将邮件、聊天、文档、任务、Agent、通话和 CRM 整合在一起，通过 @ 引用与共享 AI 记忆实现互联。旨在消除工具割裂，让团队在单一平台上完成协作与客户管理。

articles.title: megadose/holehe
articles.excerpt: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.
articles.summary: 检查邮箱是否注册过 Twitter、Instagram 等各类网站服务的 OSINT 工具，利用网站的忘记密码功能来探测邮箱关联的账号信息。适用于安全审计、隐私调查及账号关联分析，以命令行方式快速批量检测。

articles.title: smicallef/spiderfoot
articles.excerpt: SpiderFoot automates OSINT for threat intelligence and mapping your attack surface.
articles.summary: 自动化 OSINT 威胁情报工具，用于收集和分析公开信息，绘制攻击面地图。集成数百个数据源，自动关联邮件、域名、IP 等信息，适合安全研究员和蓝队用于资产发现、漏洞评估与风险排查。

articles.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
articles.excerpt: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
articles.summary: NVIDIA 出品的 LLM 流量路由层，允许应用在不改代码的前提下切换不同模型和供应商，并保持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic API 原生兼容。支持灵活的模型选择、基准测试与成本优化，适合需要多模型容灾或比价的生产环境。

articles.title: holaboss-ai/holaOS
articles.excerpt: Open-source All in One AI agent workspace. Run any agent — Claude Code, Codex — across your tools (100+ integrations + MCP), apps, browser, and files, with shared memory. Built-in models or BYOK.
articles.summary: 开源的一体化 AI Agent 工作空间，可运行 Claude Code、Codex 等任意 Agent，连接 100+ 集成与 MCP 协议，统一操作工具、浏览器和文件，并配备共享内存。支持内置模型或自带密钥，适合追求自动化工作流的重度用户。

articles.title: kepano/obsidian-skills
articles.excerpt: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
articles.summary: 面向 Obsidian 的 Agent 技能包，让 AI 学会使用 Obsidian CLI 与 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 等开放格式。用户用自然语言即可驱动 Agent 自动建笔记、维护知识库，大幅提升知识管理效率，适合笔记重度用户。

articles.title: 3b1b/manim
articles.excerpt: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
articles.summary: 用于制作数学讲解视频的动画引擎，由 3Blue1Brown 开源。通过 Python 代码精确控制数学对象和动画帧，自动生成高质量说明视频，适合教育创作者、数学科普作者制作可视化教学内容。

articles.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
articles.excerpt: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
articles.summary: 一套开箱即用的 AI 代理团队，包含前端开发、Reddit 社区运营、创意注入、现实检查等各类专业化 Agent，每个都具备独立人格、流程和技能。适合需要多角色协作、快速搭建自动化业务线的场景。

articles.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
articles.excerpt: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.
articles.summary: LTX-2 音视频生成模型的官方 Python 推理与 LoRA 训练包，支持从文本生成音画同步的视频内容。开发者可用它进行模型推理、微调定制，适用于影音内容创作、广告生成等多媒体 AI 应用场景。

articles.title: lightningpixel/modly
articles.excerpt: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
articles.summary: 本地运行的桌面应用，利用 GPU 从图片直接生成 3D 模型。无需云端服务，保证数据私密的同时实现快速建模，适合游戏开发者、3D 设计师和创作者快速将 2D 图像转化为可用的 3D 资产。

articles.title: infiniflow/ragflow
articles.excerpt: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
articles.summary: 领先的开源 RAG（检索增强生成）引擎，将前沿 RAG 技术与 Agent 能力深度融合，为 LLM 构建优质上下文层。提供完整的数据接入、解析、检索和问答流程，适合企业构建知识库问答、文档洞察等应用。

articles.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. articles.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
articles.excerpt: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

articles.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

articles.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
articles.excerpt: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

articles.title: The next generation of MCP
articles.excerpt: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

articles.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
articles.excerpt: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

articles.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
articles.excerpt: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.

articles.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
articles.excerpt: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model. Kitesurf is Cloudflare’s new stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers and was designed specifically for the Agentic Cloud.

articles.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
articles.excerpt: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.

articles.title: Cloudflare is the only vendor named a Visionary in 2026 SASE and SSE reports
